patthana24.10:9.1: ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ, silaṃ, uposathakammaṃ . . . pubbe . . . jhānā cakkhuṃ . . . aniccato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha parāmāso ca sampayuttakā ca khandhā uppajjanti. (Evaṃ itare pi tīṇi ārabbha kātabbāni. Imaṃ dukaṃ parāmāsadukasadisaṃ. Lokuttaraṃ yamhi na labbhati, tamhi na kātabbaṃ.) PARĀMĀSO-CEVA-PARĀMAṬṬHA-DUKAṂ niṭṭhitaṃ. 1. Parāmāsavippayuttaparāmaṭṭhaṃ
